name: The Drunken Demon Inn
desc1: This large, crowded inn is filled with a wide assortment of scruffy-
desc2: looking ruffians. Long wooden tables are flanked with chairs here, and
desc3: the sounds of cackling laughter and angry shouts fill the air. Small
desc4: private boots near the back of the room are undoubtedly filled with
desc5: nasty characters conducting shady deals. Once in a while a fistfight
desc6: breaks out, but nobody really pays any notice. The entrance door leads
desc7: out to the east, while the tavern part of the inn continues south.
